gadgets.name: gadgets_notes_reqwhen_chk
gadgets.expression: ("kind" IS NOT 'custom') OR ("notes" IS NOT NULL)

gadgets.name: gadgets_reason_reqwhen_chk
gadgets.expression: ("timeout" IS NOT 5400000000) OR ("reason" IS NOT NULL)

gadgets.name: gadgets_email_atleastone_chk
gadgets.expression: (("email" IS NOT NULL) + ("phone" IS NOT NULL)) = 1

gadgets.name: gadgets_phone_atleastone_chk
gadgets.expression: ("level" <> 2) OR ("phone" IS NOT NULL OR "fax" IS NOT NULL)

feeds.name: feeds_error_reqwhen_chk
feeds.expression: ("status" IS NOT 'failed') OR ("error" IS NOT NULL)

devices.name: devices_powered_voltage_atleastone_chk
devices.expression: (("kind" <> 'METER') AND ("kind" <> 'SENSOR') AND ("kind" <> 'SMART_METER')) OR ("voltage" IS NOT NULL OR "watts" IS NOT NULL)

devices.name: devices_sensor_unit_reqwhen_chk
devices.expression: ("kind" <> 'SENSOR') OR (("mode" IS NOT 'MANUAL') OR ("unit" IS NOT NULL))

devices.name: devices_sensor_note_reqwhen_chk
devices.expression: ("kind" <> 'SENSOR') OR (("mode" IS NOT 'MANUAL') OR ("note" IS NOT NULL))

devices.name: devices_smartmeter_firmware_reqwhen_chk
devices.expression: ("kind" <> 'SMART_METER') OR (("grade" IS NOT 'A') OR ("firmware" IS NOT NULL))

devices.name: devices_switch_note_reqwhen_chk
devices.expression: ("kind" <> 'SWITCH') OR (("legacy_position" IS NOT 'OFF') OR ("note" IS NOT NULL))
